gloss: to train; to prepare; to stock up

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {仕込|しこ}んでいませんでした

definitions.explanation: To thoroughly train someone in a skill, trade, or discipline.
To prepare ingredients or ferment products like sake, miso, or soy sauce.

definitions.gloss: to stock up; to lay in
definitions.explanation: To purchase and store goods for future sale or use.

examples.english: I was trained in the art by my master.
Training a dog to do tricks requires patience.

notes:
{仕込|しこ}む is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) with origins in traditional apprenticeship and food preparation. It implies thorough preparation over time.

ASPECT (ている):
{仕込|しこ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates preparation is in progress. For fermentation, {仕込|しこ}んで⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ indicates something has been prepared and is now aging.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [person]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧[skill]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕込|しこ}む — to train [person] in [skill]
- [product]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕込|しこ}む — to prepare/brew [product]
- ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕込|しこ}む (prepare miso)
- ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕込|しこ}む (brew sake)
- ⟦{弟子|でし}→弟子：03986_deshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕込|しこ}む (train an apprentice)
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{仕込|しこ}む (stock up on merchandise)

TRADITIONAL CONTEXT:
Originating from traditional crafts and brewing, {仕込|しこ}む implies patient, thorough preparation and often strict discipline in training.

FORMS:
⟦{仕込|しこ}み→仕込み：09206_shikomi⟧ (preparation, training, stock)
